name: videoexpress-scripting
description: Plan, script and produce multi-clip videos in VideoExpress 3.5 and later: project intake, Core Bible, multishot prompts, Creative mode styles, chaining, dialogue, sound and browser operation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, script and run multi-clip VideoExpress 3.5 videos: intake, Core Bible, multishot prompts, chaining, dialogue and sound.
interface.longDescription: Turns a song, story or narration into a clip-by-clip VideoExpress prompt pack: guided project intake, a locked Core Bible for characters, outfits and locations, the VE multishot prompt format, 43 tested Creative mode style sheets, clip chaining, lip-synced dialogue, production sound, a failure-to-fix table for drifting characters, flipped cameras, dark scenes, text in footage and unwanted music, and a workflow for driving app.videoexpress.ai in a browser.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for a VideoExpress video. Help me plan it.
Here's my script. Turn it into a VideoExpress production.
My chained VideoExpress clips keep reversing camera direction. How do I fix it?
